rules.statement: The Last Will No. 418 of 22nd July 1850 creates a fideicommissum in perpetuity and the deceased should be presumed dead for probate purposes.
rules.supporting_quote: (a) that Mohideen Natchchia executed the Last Will No. 418 of 22nd July 1850, a certified copy of the duplicate of which is produced marked P2, and that it was admitted to probate in D. C. Colombo Case No. 1734. (b) that P2 creates a fideicommissum in perpetuity. (c) that there is no proof that Jaleel is alive and should be presumed to be dead. 99 Learned
